messages.subject: Project Indigo — term sheet for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Anita, Marcus — attached is the term sheet reflecting the agreed economics: £18m new money, £42m pre / £60m post, £12.00 per Series B share, 1.0x non-participating preference, broad-based weighted-average anti-dilution and a single Brindley board seat. Exclusivity runs 45 days from signature. It's subject to contract save for the binding paragraphs. Happy to walk through before you sign.

--
James Osei
Senior Associate, Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 1142
